comment: Conformance pack cases this engine renders differently from the spec model, one entry per cause with its open ticket. See test/conformance-pack.test.ts.

entries.cause: the pinned pack predates the ruling that invisible lines do not consume a continuation marker
the pinned pack predates the ruling that an abbreviation definition missing every container frame defines at document level
the pinned spec model predates the ruled block-form boundary after a quoted term
the pinned spec model predates the ruling that a tab after a marker separator is content and keeps the content column
the pinned spec model predates the ruling that the block after an attribute run, not the run, decides whether a + attaches
the pinned spec model predates the ruling that a marker between an item's columns folds unless it matches the list on every axis
the pinned spec model predates the ruling that a list marker at column 0 is lazy text of a list inside a description it does not reach
the pinned spec model predates the T6 ruling that a continuation cell past the last column is a new cell (carve#4530); these match the pack on carve main
untriaged day-one drift in the fences family
untriaged day-one drift in the lazy family
untriaged day-one drift in the notes family
untriaged day-one drift in the ownership family
untriaged day-one drift in the roundtrip family
an unclosed fence in a description or footnote body drops its trailing blank run
an indented plus in a note body absorbs a following quote that belongs to the document
